rating.method: batch Elo-style rating with half-point draws

bootstrap.cluster: task (secret) — both directions and all pairings kept together

role_rating.method: additive role ratings: leg strength g1[G1] + g2[G2] - d[D]; fixture P(first leg cheaper) = sigmoid(strength difference); half-point draws

teams.identifiability_note: Role fixtures (A+B vs B+A, one defender) identify differences in clue-giver minus receiver skill; self-play fixtures (A+A vs B+B) identify differences in g1+g2; homogeneous fixtures identify composite differences. Components are centred over the team models and a value is shown only when the fixture design identifies it exactly.
